/rigel-media/4f8d88dc-07a3-4ff8-959c-63a.description: Bicho is open-source error tracking built for AI agents. No dashboard: connect your MCP client and your agent searches issues, reads stack traces, and resolves them while you stay in the editor. Runs in your own Cloudflare account, D1 and R2 hold the evidence. Apache-2.0, no subscription, just your Cloudflare bill.Already on Sentry? Keep your SDK, swap the DSN.
